$comment: Claude Code context windows by model-id prefix (ADR-001 section 5.5, ADR-002 H.2). Longest matching prefix wins; ids containing [1m] are 1,000,000; anything else is `default`. All values are estimated.local: evidence in a session (compaction preTokens, peak usage across every scope) raises the value to the smallest documented window >= the evidence from {200k, 1M} (derived.exact, lowerBound = evidence); above 1M the evidence itself is kept and labelled unknown, never a guessed 2M. Evidence column: max observed ctx / compaction preTokens over the local corpus described in docs/format-claude-code.md (opus-5 and opus-4-8 compaction preTokens of ~1.00M prove the 1M window).

windows.evidence: not calibrated: peak ctx 188,834 without compaction; inherits the fable-5 family value
not calibrated: peak ctx 24,515; documented 200k window
